title: Email: Fw: Wow! You guys rocked  it ...

content.subject: Fw: Wow! You guys rocked  it ...

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Sunday, April 26, 2020 12:06 AM
To: Albom, Mitch <malbom@freepress.com>; Alter, Marlowe <malter@freepress.com>; Birkett, David <dbirkett@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>; Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Ford, Ryan <rford@freepress.com>; Monarrez, Carlos <cmonarrez@freepress.com>; Sabin, Rainer <RSabin@freepress.com>; Sang, Orion <OSang@freepress.com>; Seidel, Jeff <jseidel@freepress.com>; Solari, Chris <CSOLARI@lsj.com>; St. James, Helene <hstjames@freepress.com>; Sung, Elaine <ESung@freepress.com>; Windsor, Shawn <swindsor@freepress.com>
Subject: Wow! You guys rocked it ... 
 
All: Thanks for all the incredible work you’re doing, especially in the face of unprecedented challenges. I’m truly amazed with how you all continue to deliver.

I wanted to say thanks to everyone who helped on the NFL draft team this weekend. Sports drove 1 million pageviews on Saturday alone, the best single day we’ve had this year, and for the three-day draft we ranked in 2.2 million. Amazing work under tiresome conditions. Our audience strategies succeed because of the skill you have and the work you put in. Thanks for executing to perfection.

I want to encourage everyone to keep up the great work. What we’re asking you to do is not easy, and it’s only going to get more difficult as we move into the typically slower months of May/June/July. Seek unique stories. Write often, even in short bursts.  Don’t let our audience forget we exist, but also make sure to take care of yourselves. That’s our daily mission.

This week, Dave/Omari/Orion/Shawn are out on furlough. That’s a major chunk of our content production. Please do your part to make sure we maintain a steady flow of content. Kirk/Elaine are running the show. If they need something, please jump on it. ALSO: If you have vacation requests, please get them to be when possible. This is a good time to start thinking about them.
Thank you for providing the best sports coverage in the Midwest. I’d put our coverage up against anyone.
It’s an honor to work with each of you.
And now that I’ve made this all sappy …
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
